cause_quote: The introducing diff ran `const prepared = await preparedPromise;` before calling the helper that started `const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), NARRATION_TIMEOUT_MS);`, giving generation a fresh ten seconds after preparation.
user_saw: A narrated progress update could appear in chat more than ten seconds after the narration request began.
summary: The fix gives model preparation and text generation a shared ten-second deadline and discards narration that finishes after it.
reasoning: I checked the feature’s introducing diff and confirmed that its first version already awaited asynchronous model preparation before starting the generation timer. The path history and the fix’s parent-side diff show that the same ordering persisted after the narration code was split and utility completion routing changed.
